verdict.description: Use 'approve' iff blocking is empty and active verification succeeded; otherwise 'request_changes'.

summary.description: Concise factual synthesis of what was checked and why the change passes or fails.

blocking.description: Real correctness, safety, scope, regression, test-weakening, or core-need defects that MUST be fixed before merge. Prefix with '[Needs human decision]' when fixing requires a product or architecture tradeoff.

notes.description: Optional non-blocking observations or polish suggestions. Never block approval or trigger re-review.

commands_run.description: Deterministic verification commands and edge-case probes executed during this review.
